title: The Republican urge to start wars in the Middle East
gist: Yglesias argues that by late September 2026 Trump's second term is failing: the Iran war (Operation Epic Fury, Strait of Hormuz closure), the tariffs and the deficit-financed One Big Beautiful Bill are all pushing up living costs, while immigration remains Trump's best issue despite overreach. He tells Democrats to avoid executive-action purism and copy Kelly Ayotte's disciplined New Hampshire model.

insights.claim: The claim that coalitions cannot be disciplined in the social-media era is learned helplessness; Republicans have been disciplined on abortion while reckless elsewhere.
insights.speaker: Matthew Yglesias
insights.so_what: Political discipline is a choice, so expect parties to differ in how predictable their policy is.
insights.quote: I often hear that it’s impossible for political coalitions to be disciplined in the social media era, but while I agree that it’s hard, I think this is learned helplessness.
